description: Input: the same fields as quote_revision, plus attempt. Start a revision of a run made by make_faceless (paid): a NEW run that renders the video again with the shots you change, by changes (a shot and what to generate for it) or by document (the whole edited document); pass exactly one. Call quote_revision first and show the user the price. An identical request returns the same run it started before, so a call repeated after a lost answer starts nothing new; to start a second revision with the same request on purpose, pass attempt 2. A revision that delivers is charged its quoted total; one that fails is charged nothing. An original has a limit on revisions running at once and on revisions failed or unfinished, and paid edits of it close some days after it finished; a refusal names which. While paid edits are closed it answers editing_disabled and charges nothing. The result is a new run: call get_run with its poll.arguments; once it succeeded it is editable under its own run_id. Price: each shot generated anew: picture 7, clip 49, clip with a new picture 56; plus 13 to render. A revision that generates nothing: 13. A kept candidate adds nothing. Quote first with quote_revision; list_prices names every price.
name: revise_run
title: Revise a run
